title: Bezalel Makes the Table of Showbread and the Lampstand
description: Bezalel makes the table of acacia wood overlaid with pure gold, with a frame, a gold rim, rings, and carrying poles, as well as dishes, bowls, pitchers, and basins of pure gold. Then he makes the lampstand of pure gold, hammered out, with six branches, almond-shaped cups with buds and flowers, and seven lamps—all made from one talent of gold.
